title: Compliance and Policy Training Videos Without a Studio (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: Compliance Training Videos Without a Studio
bullets: Accurate, consistent, easy to follow
Updated every time a policy changes
Start from the deck you already have
slides.notes: Your policy deck already holds your compliance training. Here's how to turn it into a clear narrated video, without a studio or voice talent.

slides.title: Cut the Deck to What People Do
bullets: What the rule is
Why it matters, in one sentence
What to do in common situations
Who to contact and how
slides.notes: Start from the approved policy, then strip out the background and history. Staff mainly need the rule, why it matters, and what to do.

slides.title: Write One Rule Per Slide
bullets: Before: Gifts and hospitality
After: Declare any gift over the policy limit within five working days
Before: Data handling
After: Lock your screen whenever you leave your desk
slides.notes: Rewrite every headline as an instruction. A headline like this is a complete takeaway, even if someone only glances at the slide.

slides.title: Speaker Notes Become the Narration
bullets: Explain it like you would to a colleague
Keep sentences short
Spell out acronyms the first time
Add a scenario after each key rule
slides.notes: Write your notes the way you'd explain the rule to a colleague. Then add a scenario, like Priya and the supplier hamper, so the rule sticks.

slides.title: Make It Accessible and Easy to Update
bullets: Burned-in captions on
Contrast of 4.5:1 for normal text
Label Do and Don't in words
Policy change: edit the slide and note, export again
slides.notes: Turn captions on and check contrast so everyone can follow. When a threshold changes, edit the slide and note, export again, and the narration matches.

slides.title: Ordinary Policy Deck In, Extraordinary Video Out
bullets: Basic: narration, captions, transitions
Pro: a.i. directs the video
Works with .pptx and Google Slides
slides.notes: On Pro, a.i. directs your compliance video, giving each rule one clear scene timed to the narration. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
